purpose: Turn verified journey, route and milestone signals into explainable delivery progress and exception intelligence.
rules: Only verified journey/location/milestone inputs may produce operational delivery intelligence.
ETA is VERIFIED only when sufficient live or recorded location and route data exists; otherwise it is UNAVAILABLE.
A safety or security hold takes precedence over delivery speed or ETA optimization.
A critical verified security event may mark delivery AT_RISK or EXCEPTION but must not trigger unsupported external dispatch.
Vehicle health conditions may create a SAFETY_HOLD recommendation when verified and policy thresholds are met.
Connectivity loss may preserve the last verified state but must never fabricate current location or ETA.
Route deviation and delivery-window exceptions require explainable evidence.
No automated customer penalty, driver discipline, vehicle control or emergency claim is permitted.
